title: Microsoft Purview: preserve shared cloud attachment versions for users on hold
summary: The roadmap facts and the narrowly stated documentation gaps are supported. The instruction for reviewing holds starts inside a case without explaining how to reach it; the existing label-policy guidance also needs a fuller route and the PowerShell parameter's preview qualification.

claims.claim: A cloud attachment links to a live file stored in SharePoint or OneDrive rather than embedding a copy.
claims.quote: Cloud attachments are links to files stored in SharePoint or OneDrive rather than embedded copies. Because a cloud attachment points to a live file stored in Microsoft 365 services that you can modify after sharing

claims.claim: By default, eDiscovery collects the most current cloud attachment version for a review set or export.
claims.quote: By default, the eDiscovery workflow for collecting cloud attachments only includes adding the most current version of a cloud attachment to a review set or for export.

claims.claim: The collected current version can differ from the shared version and no longer contain content present at sharing.
claims.quote: So, content that was present in the cloud attachment at the time it was shared might be removed and doesn't exist in the current version that's added to the review set or exported.

claims.claim: The existing cloud attachment retention-label configuration creates and labels a copy of the file at sharing.
claims.quote: When you choose the option to apply a retention label to cloud attachments, for compliance purposes, a copy of that file is created at the time of sharing. Your selected retention label is then applied to the copy

claims.claim: The labeled copy is stored in the Preservation Hold library.

claims.claim: Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Label policies > Auto-apply a label is the route for the existing cloud attachment label policy.
claims.quote: If you're using data lifecycle management: Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Label policies > Auto-apply a label
claims.fix: The printed route correctly reaches the wizard but stops before its cloud-attachment choice. Extend it to 'Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Label policies > Auto-apply a label > Choose the type of content you want to apply this label to > Apply label to cloud attachments and links shared in Exchange, Teams, Viva Engage, and Copilot'. The wizard page is documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/apply-retention-labels-automatically and the option's full label is stated at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/ai-m365-copilot#capabilities-supported; cite the latter for that label.

claims.claim: New-RetentionCompliancePolicy with -Name, -SharePointLocation <site URL> and -RetainCloudAttachment $true creates the existing cloud attachment auto-apply label policy.
claims.quote: This example creates a new auto-apply label policy targeted to cloud attachments named Marketing Department with the specified details. Note: This parameter is currently in Preview, is not available in all organizations, and is subject to change.
claims.fix: Keep the call and its policy-creation qualification. Add to controls[1].note: 'The PowerShell RetainCloudAttachment parameter is currently in Preview, is not available in all organizations, and is subject to change.' This qualification is in https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/exchangepowershell/new-retentioncompliancepolicy#-retaincloudattachment.
